meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用增加聊天消息渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Telegram chat to your existing app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add a chat channel to your app.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把 Telegram 渠道集成进项目:从 channels 分支复制适配器、配对与格式化辅助代码及测试,注册适配器、安装 @chat-adapter/telegram 并构建验证,再用 4 位配对码把你的 Telegram 聊天接入。
howto.when: 当你要给项目接入 Telegram 机器人渠道时接管,比如在 /setup 流程中,或之后用 /init-first-agent、/manage-channels 接上这个频道。

say.text: 给项目加上 Telegram 频道集成
say.note: 会复制适配器代码并安装依赖

say.text: 帮我配对 Telegram 机器人,把聊天接上
say.note: 会打印 4 位配对码,发回机器人即可

say.text: 用 /manage-channels 把 Telegram 频道接到这个文件夹

howto.what_en: After install, Claude adds Telegram channel integration to the project: it copies the adapter, pairing and markdown-sanitize helpers plus tests from the channels branch, registers the adapter, installs @chat-adapter/telegram, builds and validates, then pairs your chat with a 4-digit code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a Telegram bot channel to the project, e.g. inside /setup, or later via /init-first-agent or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add Telegram channel integration to the project
say_en.note: Copies adapter files and installs deps

say_en.text: Pair my Telegram bot and connect the chat
say_en.note: Prints a 4-digit code to send the bot

say_en.text: Use /manage-channels to wire the Telegram channel to this folder
